reproduction: Under a compact parent, contained default actions measured 32px instead of the required normal 36px. The same native root selector demonstrates correction.
fix: OverlayTheme with an explicitly authored density excludes inherited density tokens from its CSS copy. Overlay families supply normal; named theme tokens, direct control overrides and explicit descendant compact scopes remain supported.
